Time spent in dark chamber:
```{r}
#periphery_preference = time spent in periphery / time spent in center
 df<-  df %>% mutate(time_dark=df$`In zone Closed_arm1 cumulative`+df$`In zone Closed_arm2 cumulative`)
 df<-  df %>% mutate(time_light=df$`In zone Open_arm1 cumulative`+df$`In zone Open_arm2 cumaltive`+ df$`O1_round cumulative`+df$`O2_round cumulative`)
# 
# #relative time spent in light over dark
 df<-  df %>% mutate(light_preference=time_light/(time_light+time_dark)*100) 
#relative time spent in dark over light
df<-  df %>% mutate(dark_preference=time_dark/(time_light+time_dark)*100) 

```

LMM

#dark preference
```{r}
#Loading packages for linear mixed effects modelling
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)

df$Week <- factor(df$Week , levels = c("Preinduction","1st week post induction","2nd week post induction"))

levels(df$Week)[levels(df$Week) == "1st week post induction"] <- "1st week"
levels(df$Week)[levels(df$Week) == "2nd week post induction"] <- "2nd week"

#creating a linear model of the same variables as included in the anova
m_anova <-lmer(dark_preference ~  Week + (1|ID), data=df)
summary(m_anova)

# Obtain estimated marginal means
emmeans_results <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ Week)

# for plot
emmeans_results_df <- as.data.frame(emmeans_results)


# Perform pairwise comparisons
pairwise_results <- contrast(emmeans_results, method = "pairwise")

# Display the results
summary(pairwise_results)

#bonferroni
pwc <- pairs(emmeans_results, adjust = "bon")
pwc
```



# assumption checks
```{r}
p_load(performance)

check <- check_model(m_anova)
check
```

#assumption checks
```{r}
qqnorm(residuals(m_anova)); qqline(residuals(m_anova))  # Q-Q plot - some tails
shapiro.test(residuals(m_anova))  # Shapiro-Wilk test (for small samples)

```

#assumption checks


```{r}
#assumption check 1 - Normality of residuals (should be normally distributed) 
qqnorm(resid(m_anova))
qqline(resid(m_anova))
shapiro.test(residuals(m_anova)) 

```

```{r}
#checks for distribution, compliments residual plot
hist(resid(m_anova)) 
```

```{r}
#Assumption 2 - Homoscedasticity (variance should be consistent) - passes
plot(fitted(m_anova), resid(m_anova))
#meets assumption, evenly distributed, thus, Homoscedasticity
```

```{r}
#When you plot residuals by ID, you're looking for:
#No systematic pattern across individuals.
#No obvious trends within IDs (e.g., all high or all low residuals).
#Ideally, residuals centered around zero with some variation.
boxplot(resid(m_anova) ~ df$ID)
```

```{r}
#Assumption 3 - confidence intervals - passes
confint(m_anova, method = "boot")
#if CI includes zero between 2.5% and 97.5% then that effect is not statistically significant.

```


# Raincloud

```{r}
# Convert emmeans pairwise comparisons to data frame (BONFERRONI already applied in pwc)
pairwise_results_oft <- as.data.frame(pwc)

# Filter significant results (optional, not required for plotting)
sig_results_oft <- pairwise_results_oft %>%
  dplyr::filter(p.value < 0.05)

# Add significance labels
sig_labels_oft <- pairwise_results_oft %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    label = dplyr::case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    )
  )

# View labeled results
sig_labels_oft
```



```{r}

library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

# IMPORTANT: ensure this is a data.frame
pairwise_results_oft <- as.data.frame(pwc)

# pre-compute safe y-position reference (NEVER rely on df inside pipe)
y_max <- max(df$dark_preference, na.rm = TRUE)

sig_labels_oft <- pairwise_results_oft %>%
  
  # split contrasts into groups
  separate(contrast, into = c("group1", "group2"), sep = " - ") %>%
  
  mutate(
    # significance labels (Bonferroni already in pwc)
    label = case_when(
      p.value < 0.001 ~ "***",
      p.value < 0.01 ~ "**",
      p.value < 0.05 ~ "*",
      TRUE ~ "ns"
    ),
    
    # safe, automatic y positioning
    y.position = y_max * (1 + 0.05 * row_number())
  ) %>%
  
  # explicitly use dplyr::select to avoid masking issues
  dplyr::select(group1, group2, y.position, label)

sig_labels_oft

```
Repeated measures plot
```{r}
p_load(ggpubr, ggdist)

plot_raincloud <- ggplot(df, aes(x = Week, y = dark_preference, fill = Week, color = Week)) +
  
  # Half-violin, nudged left
  stat_halfeye(
    side = "left",
    adjust = 0.5,
    justification = 1.1,
    .width = 0,
    point_colour = NA,
    alpha = 0.6,
    scale = 0.5, #make plot narrower
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.05)
  ) +
  
#  # Boxplot
#  geom_boxplot(
#    width = 0.05,
#    outlier.shape = NA,
#    alpha = 0.7,
#    color = "black",
#    show.legend=FALSE,
#    position = position_nudge(x = -0.15)
#  ) +
  
  
  #connect IDs
  geom_line(
  aes(x = Week, y = dark_preference, group = ID),
  color = "gray50",
  linewidth = 0.5,
  alpha = 0.4
) +

 # Jittered points
  geom_jitter(
    width = 0.04,
    size = 2.0,
    alpha = 0.5,
  ) +
  
  #add means for SE bars
  geom_point(
    data = emmeans_results_df,
    aes(x = Week, y = emmean),
    color = "black",
    size = 3.0,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.15)
  ) +
  
    
  #adding in model SE data
  geom_errorbar(
    data = emmeans_results_df,
    aes(x = Week, ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE),
    width = 0.10,
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    linewidth = 0.6,
    position = position_nudge(x = -0.15)
  ) +
  
  
  # # Add in significant lines and asterisks
  # stat_pvalue_manual(
  #   sig_labels_oft,
  #   label = "p.adj.signif",
  #   tip.length = 0.02,
  #   size = 6,
  #   inherit.aes = FALSE
  # ) +
  
  stat_pvalue_manual(
    sig_labels_oft,
    label = "label",
    tip.length = 0.02,
    size = 6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +

  # Manual colors
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Preinduction" = "#feca8d", "1st week" = "#f1605d", "2nd week" = "#440f76")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Preinduction" = "#feca8d", "1st week" = "#f1605d", "2nd week" = "#440f76")) +
  
  # Labels and theme
  labs(
    x = "Timepoint",
    y = "Darkness Preference %",
    fill = "Group",
    color = "Group"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(size = 16),
    legend.position = "right"
  )

plot_raincloud
ggsave("EPM_dark_preference_time.svg", plot = plot_raincloud, width = 8, height = 6)
```



# distance moved


```{r}
#Loading packages for linear mixed effects modelling
library(lmerTest)
library(lme4)

df$distance <- df$`Distance moved`


#creating a linear model of the same variables as included in the anova
m_anova <-lmer(distance ~  Week + (1|ID), data=df)
summary(m_anova)

# Obtain estimated marginal means
emmeans_results <- emmeans(m_anova, ~ Week)

# Perform pairwise comparisons
pairwise_results <- contrast(emmeans_results, method = "pairwise")

# Display the results
summary(pairwise_results)

#bonferroni
pwc <- pairs(emmeans_results, adjust = "bon")
pwc
```
